rating_source: Re-verified live during this build (not just trusted from the task brief) via three independent angles: (1) localheadspa.com detail page, fetched directly, whose visible page text literally reads '5(188 reviews)' and whose meta description states 'ReflexPedi &HeadSpa is a head spa in Palm Harbor, FL with 5 stars from 188 reviews', and whose embedded page-data JSON blob explicitly contains '"rating":5,"review_count":188' tied to the same Google place_id/photo used below; (2) that same embedded JSON's 'photos' field and 'hasMap' schema.org property resolve to Google's own CDN (lh3.googleusercontent.com) and to Google Maps place_id ChIJgxpSWvXtwogRtbr3gzsvP5U, strongly indicating this figure is itself sourced from the business's Google Business Profile; (3) an independent direct fetch of live Google Maps for that exact place_id (via a text-rendering proxy, since this sandbox cannot render Google's JS Maps UI directly) confirmed the business name 'ReflexPedi &HeadSpa', a '5.0' rating, and the same address/phone, though Google's logged-out limited view did not surface a review COUNT figure on that particular fetch. Both >= 4.5 rating and >= 10 reviews bars are cleared with wide margin, so the build proceeded.
own_site_check: reflexpedi.com, reflexpediheadspa.com and reflexpedibyrenee.com: none resolve (curl through the environment's proxy logged 'gateway answered 502 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)' / connect_rejected for all three at the DNS/connect stage, the same signature the repo's own precedent (serrano-handyman-kissimmee) treats as a non-resolving domain). The GlossGenius booking payload's own 'website_url' field is 'https://g.page/r/CbW694M7Lz-VEBI', which was directly followed and confirmed to 302-redirect to a Google Search results page (a Google 'leave a review' shortlink, matching the review_with_google_url value 'https://g.page/r/CbW694M7Lz-VEBE/review' also present in the same payload's preferences) - this is Google's own review-collection link, NOT an independent website, so has_own_site is correctly false. salonlofts.com/reflexpedi_headspa is a shared coworking-facility directory profile (Salon Lofts, the landlord), explicitly NOT this business's own site per the task brief and confirmed by its generic Salon-Lofts-branded template/URL structure. No other independent domain was found anywhere (Facebook, Instagram bio via ig_photos.py service, Groupon, Fresha, Yelp all point back to the GlossGenius booking page or to Facebook/Instagram themselves).
instagram_note: Confirmed real and active: fetched via scripts/ig_photos.py (Railway ig-photo-service), which returned 12 posts with alt text 'Video by Renee Lee on <date>', matching owner Renee Lee. Two alternate/legacy handle spellings surfaced during research and were checked but not used as primary: 'Renee_specialist_pedi' (the exact string in the GlossGenius payload's instagram_url field) and 'reflexpedi_by_renee' (linked from her Salon Lofts profile's social icons). All three plausibly point to the same person/brand; @reflexpedibyrenee was used as primary because it is the one confirmed live and returning real, current posts, and matches the handle given in the task brief.
facebook_note: Confirmed via direct fetch with a facebookexternalhit user agent: og:title 'ReflexPedi by Renee | Palm Harbor FL', og:description 'ReflexPedi by Renee, Palm Harbor. 2,290 likes - 10 talking about this - 16 were here. Renee is good at Scalp treatment, facial treatment, and foot relaxation, good combo Pedicure and HeadSpa services.' The page itself is SPA/login-walled for further content (no additional reviews/email visible beyond the og: meta tags).
brand_colors_source: Her own GlossGenius booking-site theme configuration (preferences.brand_color_override_primary / _secondary in the site payload) sets a real, self-chosen gradient of teal #3E8D9A to coral/salmon #ED8277. This is an unusually strong, first-party signal of her actual brand identity (she picked these colors herself for her own booking page), used as the basis for this site's palette below (deepened/muted slightly for on-cream text contrast, and to keep it visually distinct from this repo's existing palettes, none of which pair teal with coral - see palette_note).
palette_note: Teal + coral 'wellness clinic' palette: accent-deep #2d6f78 (deep teal, derived by deepening her real booking-site teal #3E8D9A for AA contrast), accent-mid #d9806c (warm coral, derived from her real booking-site coral #ED8277), warm cream bg #f7f3ec, dark teal-charcoal ink #24312f. Distinct in hue-pairing from every palette already used in this repo (mizu dark-gold, amani mocha, mare pure-teal/chocolate, alea gold-on-white, pausa sage, and the coral-fairy/caramelo/esmeralda/teal-acero/violeta-dark/steel-blue set listed in SKELETONS-V2.md): none of those pair a teal with a coral the way this business's own real brand configuration does. Built on the light-v2 skeleton (light base) since the real photos and brand config read as bright, clinical-calm wellness rather than moody/dark.
services_note: Full 24-item menu with exact names, prices and durations extracted directly from the GlossGenius booking page's __NEXT_DATA__ payload via scripts/glossgenius_dossier.py (first-party source, most reliable possible: this is literally her own live price list). Two obvious typos present verbatim in her own published data were corrected only for display spelling (not price/duration/identity): 'Migriane/Psoriasis Relief Treatment' -> 'Migraine/Psoriasis Relief Treatment', and 'Luxry Essential Oils headSpa' -> 'Luxury Essential Oils HeadSpa'. about_text_source: Welcome to ReflexPedi & HeadSpa, a private, one-on-one wellness sanctuary. Because I work with only one client at a time, your session is never rushed and completely tailored to your needs. Experience the luxury of undivided attention, and a peaceful environment designed solely for your relaxation. (Verbatim from the GlossGenius booking payload's 'about' field, her own words.)

reviews.text: I am the privileged first client of Rene's unique headspa. She told me she learned these techniques when she lived in China before becoming a US citizen. She has brought amazing equipment and products that relaxed my neck/shoulders, and head. It's a gotta try it to really understand it. She has amazing techniques. The facial masks she put on my face while she was treating my head. My skin feels amazing.
reviews.author: Kathy C.

reviews.text: This morning I pulled the trigger and went to one of those headspa places, you know, the ones you see on TikTok where they wash your hair, scalp and massage you. I was there for a little over an hour and I HIGHLY recommend doing it even if it's just once! DO IT! Treat yourself.
reviews.author: Meaghan B.

reviews_note: Only 2 named, verbatim testimonials could be sourced this session despite an extensive multi-platform search (per pipeline rule, shown as-is rather than padded to a fake 3-5: 'si hay menos de 3 [reviews], mostrar las que haya'). Both are real, attributed testimonials submitted through the business's own Salon Lofts directory profile testimonial widget (salonlofts.com/reflexpedi_headspa), fetched directly. Individually-attributed Google reviews with names could NOT be reached despite trying: Groupon (both live deal URLs given in research, plus a Googlebot-UA and a text-proxy attempt, all either 403 WAF-blocked or the specific deal had expired/redirected to a generic city-wide listing page with no reflexpedi-specific content); Yelp (403 on every attempt); Facebook reviews/about tabs (SPA login-wall, only og: meta tags reachable); Google Maps itself (a text-rendering proxy did reach a live, logged-out place page confirming name/rating/address/phone, but Google's logged-out limited view does not surface individual review text); the Wayback Machine has no archived snapshot of either Groupon deal URL. The two Kathy C. / Meaghan B. quotes above were corroborated by the same general sentiment appearing (without names attached) in several independent WebSearch result summaries referencing this business's Groupon reviews (phrases like 'the reflexology part was mind blowing' and 'Renee is delightful'), which were NOT used verbatim on-site since no reviewer name could be independently confirmed for them.
gallery_photos_note: Curated from three sources, every file verified with `file` (real JPEG >15KB) and visually inspected one-by-one (never chosen by filename): (1) scripts/glossgenius_dossier.py pulled 16 photos directly from her GlossGenius service menu + cover image; (2) scripts/ig_photos.py (Railway ig-photo-service) pulled 12 real photos/reel-covers from @reflexpedibyrenee; (3) one real Google Maps photo of her empty treatment room, fetched from the lh3.googleusercontent.com URL embedded in localheadspa.com's structured data for this exact business. From these 28 raw files, 10 were curated for the site: several GlossGenius images were generic stock/product photography (a stock bubble-texture background, a stock 'Pedi in a Box' product shot, two abstract icon graphics) and were discarded as not real photos of the business; several Instagram reel covers had marketing captions baked into the pixels and were either discarded (where the caption region could not be cropped out without losing the subject) or cropped to remove only the caption strip while keeping 100% real, uncropped subject content (gallery-hair-rinse.jpg cropped from bk-27, about-renee-treatment.jpg cropped from bk-20, gallery-reflexology-feet.jpg cropped from a video-player-thumbnail frame to remove a play-button icon and caption text sitting outside the actual foot/hand content). No selfie or owner-portrait was used as a gallery tile; the one real portrait of Renee (from her GlossGenius avatar) is used only as a small avatar in the Experience section, per the curation rule.
